rationale: The stock has rallied $3.88 off its morning low to trade at 99% of its intraday range, right into overhead resistance near the prior session's low ($50.51) and close ($50.96). Chasing a long position this extended above VWAP ($49.64) against a weak broader market offers poor risk-reward, while initiating a short lacks confirmation of buyer exhaustion as 1-minute candles continue printing new highs. Additionally, the wide 15.8 bps spread degrades execution quality for an immediate entry in either direction.
